details: CONFIRMED by a probe (the hermetic test with 2020 replaced by 2030). Not reachable in production: the hook and calibrate pass the real clock's time, so day file and window agree. It is a fragility the fix introduced: half of the ledger path (the window) follows the given time, the other half (append -> day_file()) follows the machine clock, so a test dated in the future breaks the same way the Numbers tests broke, mirrored. Size: 10 minutes.
evidence: lib/relay_ledger.py:31-39: day_file(when=None) uses dt.datetime.now; append() calls day_file() with no time.
lib/relay_ledger.py:58: if since and day_dt + dt.timedelta(days=1) < since: continue
failing_case: Hermetic setup (empty HOME, temp RELAY_HOME), capture("2030-03-04T09:00:00Z") returns ['s1'] and writes its line into <today's real date>.jsonl; remove usage-index.json; capture("2030-03-04T12:00:00Z") returns ['s1'] (written twice) instead of []. read() drops the whole day file because day_dt + 1 day < since (2030-03-01). On master the same sequence returns [] (window from the real clock includes today's file and the 2030 line).
fix_hint: In append(), file the line by its own time: day_file(parse_ts(event.get("ts")) or None). Production is unchanged (ts is the real now); the given time then decides both the file and the window.
pass_cases: 1. capture("2030-03-04T09:00:00Z") then index removed then capture("2030-03-04T12:00:00Z") returns [].
2. The existing tests/test_numbers_hermetic.py (2020 dates) still returns [] on the second capture.
4. A hook capture with now() of the real clock still writes its line into today's day file.
reason: tests/test_numbers_hermetic.py::test_future_given_time_files_and_windows_by_the_same_time passes, fails without the fix; the 2020 test still passes (pass case 2); gate green.
findings.summary: the window now follows the given time, but lines still go to the real clock's day file: a given time over a day ahead of the clock skips that file
